On Tue, Dec 2, 2008 at 9:46 AM, sc@rcega <daesc...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Hi Henrik!
>
> I´m processing a analysis of 27 tumors of cervical cancer using 100k
> and I´m wondering the following:
>
> Should I include in the analysis chips with patients without cancer? I
> mean "controls" -

That is alright and it is likely that it even provides you with a
better pool of reference.

>
> Should I change something since I don´t have a Y chromosome? Since I
> only have women in my set.

No, you don't have to worry about the sex chromosomes. For your ChrX
estimates, it is actually an easier case to have all samples being
diploid. There are no ChrY on the 100K platforms so that is not an
issue.

Cheers
